name: tech.mydev-tools/habitscore
description: Reliability scoring for agent jobs and habit analytics. Pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

environmentVariables.name: HABITSCORE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a Base wallet holding USDC. Signs payments locally and never leaves the process. Omit to run quote-only.

environmentVariables.name: HABITSCORE_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling per tool call in USD. Default 0.25.
